description:
Connect your eBay seller data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language about sales, orders, products, and marketplace fees.

Compare order totals, order counts, units sold, and fees across date ranges. Explore ordered products by item and SKU, find your best-selling items, and track daily sales. Keep amounts in their reported currencies.

You can also inspect current listing, inventory, and seller-standard information available from your connected eBay account.

defaultPrompt: How much did I sell on eBay last week?
Generate a monthly eBay sales report covering the last 30 days
Show me my top selling eBay listings for the last 14 days

name: adzviser-ebay

publication.release_notes: Ask about your eBay sales, orders, best-selling items, and marketplace fees in ChatGPT. Compare periods and explore daily sales trends.

positive.description: Monthly orders, sales and units. Fresh conversation with this eBay plugin enabled and a reviewer account with access to the eBay Demo workspace. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates at execution time and state the inclusive dates. If the workspace or account is unavailable, explain the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: How many eBay orders and units did we sell last month in eBay Demo, and what was the total order value?
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name eBay Demo. Resolve last month to the complete previous calendar month. Request metrics Orders, Order Total, Quantity (Orders), with breakdown Order Currency and no time_granularity. Report order count, units and order value separately for each returned currency. Counts may also be totaled across currencies; monetary values must not be added or converted across currencies. Distinguish order value from product revenue, fees, payouts and profit. Use only assorted_requests.ebay_request. Read structuredContent.reportingData and surface any note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget, invent no-data values, or infer a currency that was not returned.

positive.description: Compare two complete months, including a missing currency baseline. Fresh conversation with this eBay plugin enabled and a reviewer account with access to the eBay Demo workspace. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates at execution time and state the inclusive dates. If the workspace or account is unavailable, explain the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Compare eBay orders and total order value last month versus the month before in eBay Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use one retrieve_reporting_data call with workspace_name eBay Demo, two date_ranges pairs for the complete previous calendar month and the month before it, and metrics Orders and Order Total with breakdown Order Currency. Omit time_granularity. Match each currency across the two periods and show later minus earlier values and percentage changes where the earlier value is present and nonzero. If a currency has no returned baseline row, show the comparison as unavailable; do not turn a missing row into zero or calculate a percentage from it. Keep currencies separate. Use only assorted_requests.ebay_request. Read structuredContent.reportingData and surface any note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget, invent no-data values, or infer a currency that was not returned.

positive.description: Rank sold items using line-item quantities and product revenue. Fresh conversation with this eBay plugin enabled and a reviewer account with access to the eBay Demo workspace. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates at execution time and state the inclusive dates. If the workspace or account is unavailable, explain the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: What were the top five eBay items by units sold last month in eBay Demo? Include their SKUs and product revenue.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the complete previous calendar month and workspace_name eBay Demo. Request Quantity (Orders) and Product Revenue (Orders) with Item ID (orders), Item Name, SKU (Orders), and Product Currency (Orders). Omit time_granularity. Rank returned item/SKU groups by units sold in descending order and show up to five, keeping item IDs, names and SKUs associated with their values. If one item/SKU has multiple currency rows, quantities may be combined for ranking but revenue must remain separated by currency. Preserve absent SKUs as absent. Do not substitute Item Title or SKU (Items), which describe current listings, or Order Total, which is an order-level amount. Do not invent server-side sort or limit fields. Use only assorted_requests.ebay_request. Read structuredContent.reportingData and surface any note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget, invent no-data values, or infer a currency that was not returned.

positive.description: Seven-day sales trend and highest-sales day by currency. Fresh conversation with this eBay plugin enabled and a reviewer account with access to the eBay Demo workspace. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates at execution time and state the inclusive dates. If the workspace or account is unavailable, explain the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: Show daily eBay orders and total order value for last week in eBay Demo. Which day had the most sales?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve last week to the previous complete Monday-Sunday week. Use workspace_name eBay Demo, one inclusive date_ranges pair, time_granularity Date, metrics Orders and Order Total, and breakdown Order Currency. Present returned dates in chronological order and identify the highest Order Total day, including ties, separately for each returned currency. Date belongs in time_granularity, not breakdowns. Do not fabricate rows for missing days or compare currency amounts as if they shared a unit. Use only assorted_requests.ebay_request. Read structuredContent.reportingData and surface any note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget, invent no-data values, or infer a currency that was not returned.

positive.description: Monthly marketplace fees, separate from order value. Fresh conversation with this eBay plugin enabled and a reviewer account with access to the eBay Demo workspace. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates at execution time and state the inclusive dates. If the workspace or account is unavailable, explain the access problem instead of switching workspaces.
positive.prompt: How much were our eBay marketplace fees last month in eBay Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name eBay Demo and the complete previous calendar month. Request Total Marketplace Fees with breakdown Order Currency and no time_granularity. Report the returned marketplace fee amount separately for each currency. Do not add Transaction Fees as a second fee because both labels map to the same underlying marketplace fee, and do not substitute order value, total fee basis amount, tax or seller payout. Treat a missing fee value as unavailable rather than assuming zero. Use only assorted_requests.ebay_request. Read structuredContent.reportingData and surface any note_of_assumption. Do not open a widget, invent no-data values, or infer a currency that was not returned.

negative.description: Unsupported refunds. Explain that this reporting plugin cannot issue refunds, cancel orders or change payments. Do not invoke its discovery, reporting or preview tools as a substitute, and do not claim a refund occurred.
negative.prompt: Refund every eBay order from last month in eBay Demo.

negative.description: Unsupported listing edits. Explain that the plugin can report on eBay data but cannot change listing prices or publish updates. Do not call this plugin's tools or claim any listing was changed.
negative.prompt: Increase all my eBay listing prices by 10% and publish the changes.

negative.description: Unsupported data source. Explain that this plugin supports eBay only. Do not call its tools, send a Shopify request key or substitute eBay figures. A separate Shopify connector is required.
negative.prompt: Use this eBay plugin to show my Shopify sales last month.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website (https://adzviser.com). This plugin reports on connected eBay seller data; it does not offer in-plugin purchases, checkout, payment processing, listing changes or order refunds.
